description:
Subject: Release of Sentiment Analyzer v1.2.0 (ID: sentiment-analyzer-1.2.0)

Dear Team,

We are pleased to announce that the Sentiment Analyzer plugin (version 1.2.0, identifier **sentiment-analyzer-1.2.0**) is now available for integration. Classified as a **sentimentPlugin**, this module analyses text to determine both polarity and intensity of sentiment, and it supports multiple languages out of the box. Its core description reads: “Analyzes text to determine sentiment polarity and intensity, supporting multiple languages.”

For your reference, the plugin’s configuration includes the following extra parameters: it can process English (**en**), Spanish (**es**), German (**de**) and French (**fr**) texts, and it operates with a confidence threshold of **0.75**. Please update your systems accordingly and let us know if any issues arise.
